# katapult_disks (Data Source)

Lists disks belonging to the provider organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every disk in the provider organization.
data "katapult_disks" "all" {}

# Build an ID-keyed inventory without relying on list positions.
locals {
  disks_by_id = {
    for disk in data.katapult_disks.all.disks : disk.id => disk
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `disks` (Attributes List) Disks ordered lexically by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the disk.
- `name` (String) The name of the disk.
- `size_in_gb` (Number) Size of the disk in GB.
- `state` (String) Current state of the disk.
- `virtual_machine_fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the assigned Virtual Machine, or null when unassigned.
- `virtual_machine_id` (String) The ID of the assigned Virtual Machine, or null when unassigned.
- `wwn` (String) World Wide Name identifier of the disk.
